CIRCLE TIME · AGE 2

Circle Time

The rug is ready — sit down together and start with a hello.

Circle time is how a preschool morning starts: a hello, some moving, a story, a goodbye. It works just as well on a living-room rug — one grown-up, one toddler, about five minutes, with the class on one screen and one moment at a time.

Circle Time 1Age 2

Hello School! Circle Time

A short preschool-style circle time: hello rhythm, copy-me movement, listening games, faces, a tiny story and goodbye — then off the rug together.
